contract_rule: the USDInd contract with the nearest expiry at least 2 trading days after the day, lag-0 checked against EURUSD (lags [-3, -2, -1, 0, 1, 2, 3]); no qualifying contract = no dollar data, the day never counts and the horizon is not extended
cost: Gross of cost on bid prices (no spread, slippage or swap) — not a trading result.
drop_is_not_failure: The test is weak by the owner's choice of horizon. A DROP is not evidence that the model fails; only a KEEP is a finding.
facts: HAR-X and HAR are gold_bbnr's frozen OLS fits on every usable day up to 2026-11-20 (the range is in the model section; the hourly dollar index starts in 2017). gold-bb-nyrange was scored 2026-11-23: the historical cell gold_harx_vs_har was KEEP at 0.847 x HAR's MSE on 2 211 walk-forward days 2018-01-02 .. 2026-11-20.
The frozen fit used all history, so the forward effect may be smaller than the walk-forward one. That is what this test measures.
LightGBM and the MLP were DROP against HAR-X historically and are not forecast live.
gold_bbnr's Bollinger cells were all DROP; nothing here concerns direction or a trade.
forward_day: a settled ok day whose label date is after the commit date of PRE_REGISTRATION.json on the Berlin label clock

horizon.rule: scored once on the first 60 forward days, as soon as they exist; with fewer on 2027-04-30, recorded UNDERPOWERED — NO DECISION. The horizon is never extended.

hypothesis: mean over forward days of (HAR-X squared error - HAR squared error) < 0
target: y = log((max high - min low of the gold bars labelled 15:00-21:00 Berlin) / close of the 14:00 bar), bid prices; eligibility and target from gold_bbnr.ny_target unchanged
verdict_rule: KEEP if the bootstrap upper (1 - alpha) bound of the mean difference is below 0, else DROP
